snippet.title: NAME OF THE WILL - Demo Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
